intro.en: Custom fine-pitch wire-to-board and compact sensor harnesses using project-approved 32AWG or other fine conductors, with exact terminal, insulation, crimp and routing controls.
intro.zh: 采用项目认可的 32AWG 或其他细导体制作细间距板端与紧凑传感线束，并准确控制端子、绝缘、压接与布线。

introduction.zh: 尺寸更小，工程定义不能更少

process.zh: 细线尺度下的工艺控制

lead.en: At 32AWG scale, a small change in conductor diameter, insulation thickness, strip length or terminal position can consume much of the available process window. A buildable assembly therefore begins with the exact connector series and contact, then controls preparation, crimping, insertion, strain relief and inspection as one system.
lead.zh: 在 32AWG 尺度下，导体直径、绝缘厚度、剥线长度或端子位置的细小变化，都可能占用大量工艺窗口。可制造的组件必须从准确连接器系列与触点开始，并把线材准备、压接、装壳、应力释放和检验作为一个系统控制。

title.en: 1.0 mm Systems: Compact Does Not Mean Generic
title.zh: 1.0 mm 系统：紧凑不等于通用

copy.en: JST SH and Molex Pico-Clasp are examples of 1.0 mm-pitch wire-to-board systems that can include fine-wire contacts, yet their housings, contacts, locks, headers and tooling are different. Exact series, circuit count, header orientation, mating height and contact plating must be frozen. The pitch describes contact spacing; it does not establish interchangeability.
copy.zh: JST SH 与 Molex Pico-Clasp 都是可包含细线触点的 1.0 mm 间距板端系统，但其外壳、触点、锁止、针座与工具并不相同。必须冻结准确系列、回路数、针座方向、插合高度与触点镀层。间距只描述触点中心距，不能证明互换。

title.en: 1.25 mm and Other Families: Match the Complete Contact Set
title.zh: 1.25 mm 与其他系列：匹配完整触点体系

copy.en: Hirose DF13 includes applicable 30–32AWG contact options, while other 1.25 or 1.5 mm families may use different wire ranges, locks and ratings. A family name should be accompanied by the housing, crimp contact, header and drawing view. Verify whether the pin map is shown from the mating face, wire side or PCB side before assigning circuits.
copy.zh: Hirose DF13 的部分触点可覆盖 30–32AWG，而其他 1.25 或 1.5 mm 系列可能采用不同线径范围、锁止与额定参数。系列名称应同时关联外壳、压接触点、针座及图纸视角。分配回路前还要确认针脚图来自插合面、线端还是 PCB 端。

title.en: Header Orientation and Latch Access Define the Cable Exit
title.zh: 针座方向与锁扣空间决定出线

copy.en: Vertical, right-angle and top-entry headers place the harness in different envelopes. PCB keep-out, nearby components, enclosure walls and operator finger access affect whether a latch can be fully engaged and later released. The drawing should define cable exit direction, free length and bend onset so the first conductor segment is not forced against the housing.
copy.zh: 立式、卧式与顶插针座会形成不同的线束空间包络。PCB 禁布区、邻近器件、外壳壁及操作手指空间都会影响锁扣能否完全啮合及后续释放。图纸应定义出线方向、自由长度与弯曲起点，避免第一段导体被强压在外壳边缘。

title.zh: 线材准备：保护每一根细丝

copy.en: Fine conductors tolerate little strand loss. Wire source, nominal cross-section, strand construction, insulation material and outside diameter must fit the approved contact. Strip length is controlled with blade condition and pull-off behavior; conductor nicks, stretched insulation and displaced strands are inspected before crimping. 32AWG should never be inferred from outside diameter alone.
copy.zh: 细导体对断丝的容忍空间很小。线材来源、标称截面积、绞线结构、绝缘材料与外径必须适配认可触点。剥线长度需结合刀片状态和脱皮表现控制，并在压接前检查伤丝、绝缘拉伸及散丝。不能只凭外径判断是否为 32AWG。

title.en: Micro Crimping: Tooling, Height and Bellmouth
title.zh: 微型压接：工具、压高与喇叭口

copy.en: The terminal applicator, locator, feed, crimp die and press setup belong to the process definition. Conductor crimp height, insulation support, bellmouth, brush, cutoff tab and symmetry are evaluated against the exact terminal specification. For example, Molex publishes narrow crimp-height windows for Pico-Clasp contacts; those values apply only to the identified terminal, wire and tooling combination.
copy.zh: 端子模具、定位器、送料、压模与压力机设置都属于工艺定义。导体压高、绝缘支撑、喇叭口、刷丝、料带残留与对称性需要依据准确端子规范评价。例如 Molex 会为 Pico-Clasp 触点给出很窄的压高窗口，但这些数值只适用于指定端子、线材与工具组合。

title.zh: 触点检验：先看几何，再看外观

copy.en: A bright, neat crimp is not automatically acceptable. Cross-section evidence, measured crimp height, conductor brush, insulation grip and pull-force results reveal different failure modes. Sampling frequency and limits should follow the released process documents. If a substitute wire changes strand count or insulation diameter, the crimp setup must be reviewed rather than carried over by gauge label.
copy.zh: 外观明亮整齐的压接并不自动合格。截面证据、实测压高、导体刷丝、绝缘夹持与拉力结果分别揭示不同失效模式。抽样频率和限值应遵循已放行工艺文件；若替代线材改变绞丝数量或绝缘外径，不能只按线号沿用原压接设置。

copy.en: Miniature terminals can appear seated while the locking lance remains partially engaged. Operators need a defined insertion direction, audible or tactile confirmation where available, and a controlled pull-back check. Magnified inspection can verify terminal position, damaged locks, bent contacts and contamination before the connector is mated to a board that may be costly to replace.
copy.zh: 微型端子可能看似到位，但锁止弹片仍未完全啮合。作业应定义插入方向，在结构允许时利用声音或触感确认，并执行受控回拉检查。放大检验可在对插昂贵 PCB 前发现端子位置异常、锁扣损伤、触点弯曲与污染。

title.en: Board Integration: Route for Assembly and Service
title.zh: 板端集成：兼顾装配与维护布线

copy.en: A fine-pitch harness often shares a small enclosure with displays, sensors, fans and flex circuits. Branch length, twist, labels, adhesive anchors and service loops should support the actual assembly sequence without pulling on the header. Where repeated connectors look identical, keying, color or durable circuit identification reduces cross-mating risk during manufacturing and repair.
copy.zh: 细间距线束常与显示器、传感器、风扇及柔性电路共享紧凑外壳。分支长度、绞合、标签、粘接固定点与检修余量应服务真实装配顺序，且不能拉扯针座。多个相同外观接口并存时，应通过防错、颜色或耐久回路标识降低制造及维修中的错插风险。

title.en: Magnified and Electrical Inspection: Make Small Defects Visible
title.zh: 放大与电气检验：让微小缺陷可见

copy.en: Inspection combines visual magnification with circuit tests. Check wire order, terminal seating, conductor exposure, damaged insulation, housing cracks, label legibility and finished dimensions before point-to-point continuity and short-circuit testing. Project-specific checks can add pull force, contact resistance, insulation resistance, flex cycling or mating verification with the target board.
copy.zh: 检验应把视觉放大与回路测试结合起来。在点对点导通及短路检查前，先核对线序、端子就位、导体外露、绝缘损伤、外壳裂纹、标签可读性与成品尺寸。项目还可增加拉力、接触电阻、绝缘电阻、弯折循环或与目标 PCB 的插合验证。

specification.en: Exact housing, contact and header part numbers with mating-face and PCB-view drawings.
specification.zh: 准确外壳、触点与针座料号，以及插合面和 PCB 视角图纸。

specification.en: Circuit count, wire map, polarity, shield or twist requirements and allowed unused positions.
specification.zh: 回路数、线序、极性、屏蔽或绞合要求，以及允许空置孔位。

specification.en: Wire AWG or cross-section, strand construction, insulation material, outside diameter and color.
specification.zh: 线材 AWG 或截面积、绞线结构、绝缘材料、外径与颜色。

specification.en: Finished length, cable exit, bend envelope, anchors, labels and service-loop requirements.
specification.zh: 成品长度、出线方向、弯曲包络、固定点、标签与检修余量要求。

specification.en: Crimp specification, pull-force sampling, visual standard and any cross-section requirement.
specification.zh: 压接规范、拉力抽样、外观标准及截面分析要求。

specification.en: Prototype quantity, target equipment, electrical test and repeat-production traceability.
specification.zh: 样品数量、目标设备、电气测试及重复生产追溯要求。

q.en: Does 32AWG define the current capacity of the finished harness?
q.zh: 32AWG 能直接定义成品线束载流能力吗？

a.en: No. Conductor material and temperature rating, length, bundling, terminals, contact resistance, ambient temperature and allowable voltage drop all affect the usable circuit current.
a.zh: 不能。导体材料与耐温、长度、成束、端子、接触电阻、环境温度及允许压降都会影响回路可用电流。

q.en: Can two 1.0 mm-pitch connectors be substituted?
q.zh: 两个 1.0 mm 间距接口可以互换吗？

a.en: Pitch alone is insufficient. Housing geometry, keying, contact design, header orientation, plating, ratings and tooling must match the approved system.
a.zh: 只有间距信息不够。外壳几何、防错、触点设计、针座方向、镀层、额定与工具都必须匹配认可体系。

q.en: Can you develop from a sample?

a.en: A sample supports dimensional and visible-wire analysis, but hidden plating, material, current, pin-map responsibility and target-board requirements still need customer confirmation.
a.zh: 样品可支持尺寸与可见接线分析，但隐藏镀层、材料、电流、针脚责任及目标 PCB 要求仍需客户确认。

q.zh: 为什么需要显微或放大检验？

a.en: Fine terminals and conductors make partial seating, strand damage, small insulation defects and bent contacts difficult to judge unaided. Magnification complements, rather than replaces, measured and electrical checks.
a.zh: 细端子与细导体让不到位、伤丝、微小绝缘缺陷及触点弯曲难以用肉眼判断。放大检验是尺寸与电气检查的补充，而不是替代。
